blocks.text: Potentiometer zyada tar potential differences ka muqabla (compare) karne aur na-maloom resistance ki qeemat nikalne ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh is usool par kaam karta hai ke steady current ho to yaksan (uniform) taar par potential ka girna taar ki lambai ke tanasub mein hota hai (V ∝ l). Wheatstone bridge ki tarah yeh bhi null (balance) tareeqe se istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke potentiometer "Wheatstone Bridge ke usool" par kaam karta hai. Sahi usool yeh hai ke steady current mein yaksan taar par potential ka girna lambai ke tanasub mein hai, jaisa agle paragraphs khud samjhate hain. Bridge ke saath sirf null tareeqa mushtarka hai, usool nahi.

Potential difference aam taur par voltmeter se naapa jata hai, jo un do points ke darmiyan joda jata hai jin ka potential difference naapna ho. Zaroori hai ke voltmeter ki resistance circuit ki us resistance se bohat zyada ho jis par woh laga hai. Warna voltmeter mein kaafi current chala jayega, jo circuit ka current aur naapne wala potential difference dono badal dega. Is liye voltmeter sahi reading tabhi deta hai jab woh circuit se koi current na le. Ideal (misali) voltmeter ki resistance infinite hogi.

Kuch aalaat, jaise digital voltmeter aur cathode-ray oscilloscope, bohat zyada resistance ki wajah se taqreeban koi current nahi lete aur bohat durust hain, magar yeh mehnge aur istemal mein mushkil hain. Potential differences ko durusti se naapne aur muqabla karne ka bohat saada aala potentiometer hai.

Potentiometer mein taar ki shakal ka ek resistor R hota hai jis par terminal C sarak (slide) sakta hai (Fig. 9.31-a). C ko A se B tak le jane par A aur C ke darmiyan resistance 0 se R tak badalti hai. Agar emf E wali battery R par jori jaye (Fig. 9.31-b) to taar mein current I = E/R hai. A aur C ke darmiyan resistance ko r kahein to in points ke darmiyan potential ka girna rI = rE/R hai. Yani C ko A se B tak sarkane par r 0 se R tak, aur A–C ka potential 0 se E tak badalta hai.

blocks.alt: (a) A aur B ke darmiyan resistance ka taar; poori lambai R, aur neeche sarakne wala contact C, A se C tak hissa r. (b) Taar AB ke aar paar cell E, aur A aur sarakne wale contact C ke darmiyan voltmeter; AC hissa r.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.31 (kitab ki Figure 9.31 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Taar mein current I = E/R hai, is liye A aur C ke darmiyan potential rI = (r/R)E. C ko A se B tak sarkane par yeh 0 se E tak badalta hai; isi liye ise potential divider kehte hain.

Is intezam ko potential divider bhi kehte hain, aur is se kisi source ka na-maloom emf naapa ja sakta hai (Fig. 9.32). Yahan R ek seedha taar hai jis ka cross-section har jagah barabar hai. Jis cell ka emf Eₓ naapna ho, use galvanometer G ke zariye A aur sarakne wale contact C ke darmiyan jorte hain. Dhyan rahe ke Eₓ ka musbat terminal aur potential divider ka musbat terminal dono ek hi point A se jure hon. Loop AGCA mein agar point C aur Eₓ ka manfi terminal ek hi potential par hon to galvanometer ke dono sire ek potential par honge aur us mein current nahi behega. Is liye C ko itna sarkate hain ke galvanometer deflection na dikhaye. Is waqt cell ka emf Eₓ A aur C ke darmiyan potential difference ke barabar hai, jis ki qeemat Er/R maloom hai. Yaksan taar mein resistance lambai ke tanasub mein hoti hai, is liye:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is circuit ke liye "Fig. 9.31" likhti hai; na-maloom emf naapne wala circuit Fig. 9.32 hai.

blocks.alt: Potentiometer ke taar AB ke aar paar driver cell E. Doosra cell Ex A se galvanometer G ke raaste taar par sarakne wale contact C se juda; E aur Ex dono ke musbat terminals A ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.32 (kitab ki Figure 9.32 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: C ko itna sarkayein ke G mein current na rahe. Tab Eₓ = A aur C ke darmiyan potential = E l/L. Is waqt Eₓ se koi current nahi liya jata, is liye naap bohat durust hai.

Yahan L taar AB ki kul lambai aur l, balance (no deflection) ke baad A se C tak ki lambai hai. A aur C ke darmiyan zyada se zyada potential E ho sakta hai, is liye na-maloom Eₓ is se zyada nahi hona chahiye, warna balance point nahi milega. Eₓ tab naapa jata hai jab us se koi current nahi liya jata; isi liye potentiometer potential naapne ke sab se durust tareeqon mein se hai.
Isi tareeqe se do cells ke emfs E₁ aur E₂ ka muqabla bhi kar sakte hain. Dono cells ke liye balancing lambaiyan l₁ aur l₂ alag alag nikali jati hain. Phir:

blocks.text_alt: E₁ = E l₁/L   aur   E₂ = E l₂/L

blocks.text: In dono ko taqseem karne se (E aur L cut jate hain):
Yani emfs ki nisbat (ratio) balancing lambaiyon ki nisbat ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt: Potentiometer kya hai? Is ka kaam bayan karein (comprehensive question 9.5). Yeh aam voltmeter se zyada durust kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh ek lamba, yaksan resistance wala taar hai jis mein driver cell se steady current behta hai, is liye taar par potential barabar rate se girta hai. Na-maloom emf galvanometer ke zariye sarakne wale contact se jora jata hai, aur contact ko tab tak sarkate hain jab tak galvanometer deflection na dikhaye; tab Eₓ = E l/L. Balance par yeh naapne wale cell se koi current nahi leta, is liye asal emf naapta hai, jabke voltmeter hamesha kuch current leta hai aur is liye kam (terminal) voltage padhta hai.

items: Voltmeter tabhi durust hai jab current na le.
Potentiometer: yaksan taar AB, sarakne wala contact C aur driver cell E; potential divider: rE/R, 0 se E tak.
Null tareeqa: Eₓ = E l/L (9.52), Eₓ ≤ E; E₁/E₂ = l₁/l₂ (9.53); na-maloom cell se current nahi liya jata, is liye bohat durust.
